release_notes:
## [2.10.1](https://github.com/ginDoki19/GinArena-patch/compare/v2.10.0...v2.10.1) (2026-11-09)
## 🎉 GinArena Patch v2.10.1

This update improves CRICFy search, updates Daylio's premium patch, and clarifies playback patch descriptions.

### 🔎 CRICFy TV search

- Added **Fix search keyboard focus** for **CRICFy TV 7.4** (build 54), enabled by default.
- Helps open the search keyboard on Android TV and keeps it connected during category searches on phones and TV, including when there are no results.
- Clears the TV search when navigating or closing search.

### ✨ Daylio

- **Enable premium** for **Daylio 1.71.1** (build 289) is no longer marked experimental and is now enabled by default. You can turn it off when patching.
- Premium status is enabled locally; this is not a purchase. Account- or server-dependent features may not work.

### 📺 Clearer playback patch descriptions

- Updated the **Hide playback controls at stream open** and **Improve Android TV playback controls** descriptions for CRICFy TV, Playfy TV, CricZ TV, PlayZ TV, CrexiFy TV, and SK Tech TV.
- The descriptions clarify the existing behavior: controls can be hidden when opening a stream or switching between embedded and fullscreen playback, while the TV patch helps with remote focus and the seekbar. These are description updates, not new playback-control changes.
- Some live streams do not support seeking, even when the seekbar is accessible.

### 📦 How to update

Refresh the GinArena patch source in Morphe Manager, then patch a fresh stock app with the new patches. To update an existing patched installation, use the same Morphe signing key. If Android reports a signature conflict, back up your data before considering an uninstall.

**Full changes:** [v2.10.0 → v2.10.1](https://github.com/ginDoki19/GinArena-patch/compare/v2.10.0...v2.10.1)
